description: Defines the MIPS-specific stack walker class for processing stack frames using MIPS register context and CFI records, part of the Google Breakpad crash reporting system.

classes.name: StackwalkerMIPS
classes.description: A class for MIPS-specific stack walking, inheriting from Stackwalker, utilizing MIPS register context and CFI data.

methods.name: StackwalkerMIPS
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIPS stack walker with system info, context, memory, modules, and symbolizer.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Returns the current stack frame based on MIPS context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Determines the caller's stack frame from the current call stack, optionally using stack scanning.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Constructs caller frame using CFI frame info.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Constructs caller frame by scanning the stack for return address and frame pointer.
